headline: Treasure Coast traffic report: I-95 ramp closures, roadwork planned Nov. 20–Dec. 4
subhead: FDOT's two-week holiday report includes Martin County I-95 ramp closures, Port St. Lucie detours and overnight restrictions near Sebastian.
teaser: I-95 ramps at Martin Highway and Kanner Highway, Port St. Lucie neighborhood streets and 90th Avenue near Sebastian face scheduled closures Nov. 20–Dec. 4.
body:
Drivers across the Treasure Coast face two weeks of construction-related lane and ramp closures around Thanksgiving, including overnight work on Interstate 95 in Martin and St. Lucie counties, detours on neighborhood streets in Port St. Lucie and a planned overnight closure of 90th Avenue near Sebastian.

The Florida Department of Transportation's traffic report issued Friday, Nov. 20, covers **Nov. 20 through Dec. 4**, a longer-than-usual period that spans the Thanksgiving holiday. Many major construction projects will pause **Wednesday, Nov. 25, through Sunday, Nov. 29**, although individual work schedules vary.

The biggest immediate disruptions are planned for **Sunday and Monday nights, Nov. 22–23**, at the I-95 interchange with SW Martin Highway. Additional ramp closures near Kanner Highway and overnight restrictions in Sebastian are scheduled after the holiday. Drivers should follow posted detour signs and allow extra travel time.

## Biggest closures to know about

**I-95 at SW Martin Highway, Exit 110, Martin County:** The **northbound exit ramp to Martin Highway** and the **northbound entrance ramp from Martin Highway** are scheduled for separate closures **8 p.m. to 6 a.m. Sunday, Nov. 22, and Monday, Nov. 23**. Only one ramp will close at a time. FDOT lists Nov. 30–Dec. 3 as contingency nights.

**I-95 at SW Kanner Highway, Exit 101, Martin County:** The **southbound entrance and exit ramps** are each scheduled for overnight closures **8 p.m. to 6 a.m. Nov. 30–Dec. 3**, with one ramp closed at a time. Detours will use Bridge Road and Pratt Whitney Road for the entrance closure and a turnaround via Bridge Road for the exit closure.

**Port St. Lucie neighborhood streets:** Extended closures for drainage and utility work may affect **SW Jaslo, Koler, McCoy, McCullough and McHord avenues and SW Paar Drive** starting **7 a.m. Monday, Nov. 23**, with roads scheduled to reopen by **5 p.m. Tuesday, Nov. 24**. Contingency dates are Nov. 30–Dec. 4. Adjacent roads will not close simultaneously, and access to homes and businesses will be maintained.

**SW Port St. Lucie Boulevard:** Full overnight closures are planned intermittently between **SW Fisherman and SW Liberty avenues, 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. Nov. 23–Dec. 4**, excluding the Thanksgiving work pause. Detours will use Fisherman, Liberty and Pisano streets.

**90th Avenue near Sebastian:** Portions of **S.R. 510/90th Avenue between Sebastian Boulevard and 87th Street** are scheduled for intermittent overnight full closures **10 p.m. to 5 a.m. Nov. 30–Dec. 3** for drainage work. Detours use **85th Street, U.S. 1 and Sebastian Boulevard**. FDOT lists Dec. 6–10 as contingency dates.

**I-95 through Martin and St. Lucie counties:** Up to two lanes in each direction may close overnight in several work zones. The Thanksgiving construction pause applies to the mainline resurfacing projects described below.

## Martin County

### I-95 ramp closures and resurfacing

**I-95 from SE Bridge Road to the Martin–St. Lucie county line:** Up to two southbound lanes will close **7:30 p.m. to 5:30 a.m.**, and up to two northbound lanes **8:30 p.m. to 6:30 a.m.**, beginning Sunday, Nov. 22. FDOT lists the resurfacing schedule through Dec. 24, with **no work Nov. 25–29** for Thanksgiving. The report includes the longer schedule so drivers can plan beyond Dec. 4.

At **SW Martin Highway, Exit 110**, the northbound exit closure will require drivers to continue to **SW Becker Road, Exit 114**, take westbound Becker Road and use the southbound I-95 entrance ramp to return to the Martin Highway exit. During the separate northbound entrance closure, the detour uses **eastbound Martin Highway, northbound SW Newfield Parkway and westbound Becker Road** to enter I-95 northbound at Becker Road. Both closures are scheduled for Nov. 22 and 23 from 8 p.m. to 6 a.m.

At **Kanner Highway, Exit 101**, the southbound entrance ramp closure is scheduled Nov. 30–Dec. 3 from 8 p.m. to 6 a.m. FDOT directs motorists via **Kanner Highway, Pratt Whitney Road and SE Bridge Road** to rejoin I-95 southbound. The separate southbound exit ramp closure uses **Bridge Road, Exit 96**, with motorists returning north toward Kanner Highway. Weather contingency dates for both Kanner closures are Dec. 6–10. Only one ramp will close at a time.

### Hobe Sound, Jensen Beach and Palm City

**U.S. 1 in Hobe Sound, between SE Dixie Highway and SE Osprey Street:** One northbound lane may close **7:30 a.m. to 5 p.m.** and **9 p.m. to 7 a.m. Nov. 23–Dec. 4** for road construction. Southbound restrictions are scheduled **10 a.m. to 5 p.m. Nov. 23–Dec. 4** and **8 p.m. to 6 a.m. Nov. 22–Dec. 3**. Access to homes and businesses will be maintained, and no work is scheduled Nov. 25–29.

**S.R. A1A/NE Ocean Boulevard near the Jensen Beach Causeway:** One lane may close intermittently in either direction between **NE Shore Village Terrace and the causeway** Nov. 23–Dec. 4 for drainage and pavement widening. Flaggers will maintain two-way traffic. Additional overnight paving is planned **7:30 p.m. to 6 a.m. Nov. 30–Dec. 4**.

**S.R. 714/SW Martin Highway in Palm City:** One lane may close in either direction between **SW Stuart West Boulevard and Citrus Boulevard, 7 p.m. to 6 a.m. Nov. 22–Dec. 3**, for resurfacing, widening and light installation. Flaggers will maintain two-way traffic. No work is scheduled Nov. 25–29.

### Stuart and other local work

FDOT also lists daytime utility restrictions, generally **9 a.m. to 4 p.m. Nov. 23–Dec. 4**, on several roads: **SW Martin Highway near Martin Downs Boulevard and SW 42nd Avenue in Palm City; SE Monterey Road between U.S. 1 and SE Dixie Highway in Stuart; U.S. 1 near SE Indian Street, SE Monterey Road and NW 16th Street; SW Kanner Highway between SW Gaines Avenue and SW Salerno Road; and NE Ocean Boulevard near Joe's Point Road and Tiger Shores Beach**.

In Port Mayaca, **SW Conners Highway** near the Port Mayaca Polo Club and the Florida Trail recreation-area trailhead may have intermittent daytime lane closures during the same period. Thanksgiving work breaks are listed for these utility operations.

## St. Lucie County

### I-95 overnight lane closures

**I-95 between SW Gatlin Boulevard and south of SW Becker Road:** Two northbound lanes may close **8 p.m. to 6 a.m.** and two southbound lanes **7:30 p.m. to 5:30 a.m.**, Nov. 22–Dec. 4. Lane shifts are possible during resurfacing and pavement-marking work. No work is scheduled Nov. 25–29.

**I-95 between Glades Cut Off Road and south of S.R. 70/Okeechobee Road:** Shoulders in both directions may close **6:30 a.m. to 7 p.m.**, while up to two lanes may close **8 p.m. to 6:30 a.m. Nov. 22–Dec. 4**, for grading, signs and road improvements. No work is scheduled Nov. 25–29.

FDOT separately lists intermittent overnight utility lane closures on I-95 **between mile markers 125 and 133**, from just north of Midway Road toward Orange Avenue, **8 p.m. to 5 a.m. Nov. 30–Dec. 4**.

### Port St. Lucie Boulevard and neighborhood detours

The **SW Port St. Lucie Boulevard widening project** includes extended closures on **SW Jaslo Avenue between SW Jacoby Avenue and SW Paar Drive; SW Koler Avenue near SW Kober Road; SW McCoy Avenue near SW Jamros Street; SW McCullough Avenue between SW Jaslo Avenue and the boulevard; SW McHord Avenue near SW Kabane Street; and both directions of SW Paar Drive near the boulevard**.

These closures may begin at **7 a.m. Nov. 23** and are expected to end by **5 p.m. Nov. 24**, with Nov. 30–Dec. 4 reserved as contingency dates. FDOT says adjacent road closures will not occur simultaneously, and access to residences and businesses will remain available. Motorists should follow the posted neighborhood detours.

A separate series of full nighttime closures on **SW Port St. Lucie Boulevard between SW Fisherman and SW Liberty avenues** is scheduled intermittently **9 p.m. to 5 a.m. Nov. 23–Dec. 4** for utility work, excluding Nov. 25–29. The signed detour for through traffic uses **SW Fisherman Avenue, SW Pisano Street and SW Liberty Avenue**.

Other intermittent lane closures are listed on **SW Port St. Lucie Boulevard between SW Jordin Avenue and SW Alcantarra Boulevard, 8 a.m. to 4 p.m. Nov. 23–Dec. 4**.

### Port St. Lucie Boulevard, U.S. 1 and Midway Road

**SE Port St. Lucie Boulevard between SE Seafury Lane and SE Lennard Road:** One lane may close during the day, **8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Nov. 23–Dec. 4**, while two lanes may close intermittently overnight, **8 p.m. to 6 a.m. Nov. 22–Dec. 4**, for road and striping work.

**U.S. 1 between SE Jennings Road and NW Golden Oak Trail:** One lane in either direction may close **8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Nov. 23–Dec. 4** and **8 p.m. to 6 a.m. Nov. 22–Dec. 4** for inspection and striping work.

**U.S. 1 between Midway Road and south of Edwards Road:** One lane may close in either direction **9:30 p.m. to 6:30 a.m. Nov. 22–Dec. 3** for lighting installation, with intermittent daytime shoulder closures Nov. 23–Dec. 4.

**Midway Road between Florida's Turnpike and Selvitz Road:** Intermittent lane restrictions continue during daytime hours, **9 a.m. to 4 p.m. weekdays**, and overnight, **8 p.m. to 6 a.m. Sunday through Friday**, through December as widening work progresses.

### Fort Pierce and the North Causeway

The **new fixed S.R. A1A North Causeway Bridge** is open to motorists, but nearby road construction continues. FDOT lists intermittent lane restrictions along **U.S. 1 near Juanita Avenue, Old Dixie Highway between Sunny Lane and Juanita Avenue, Harbortown Drive, and A1A east of the new bridge** during daylight work hours through December. The old drawbridge is no longer carrying vehicle traffic. The bicycle lanes and north-side shared-use path remain closed while construction continues; pedestrians are directed to the south-side sidewalk.

FDOT prohibits lane and shoulder closures related to the North Causeway project **Nov. 25–29** to reduce Thanksgiving travel impacts.

Additional daytime utility work may affect **U.S. 1, S.R. 70/Okeechobee Road, South Kings Highway, Midway Road and Turnpike Feeder Road** in Fort Pierce. Specific blocks and dates vary; many are scheduled between **9 a.m. and 4 p.m.** through Dec. 4.

## Indian River County

### Oslo Road interchange finished; Sebastian-area restrictions remain

FDOT reports the **new I-95/Oslo Road interchange project was formally accepted Nov. 17**. **All lanes are open**, marking a change from recent traffic reports that listed overnight interchange ramp closures.

**S.R. 510/90th Avenue between Sebastian Boulevard and 87th Street:** One lane may close intermittently in either direction **8 p.m. to 6 a.m. Nov. 22–Dec. 4** for construction, with no work Nov. 25–29. An additional intermittent **full road closure is planned 10 p.m. to 5 a.m. Nov. 30–Dec. 3** for drainage work. Northbound traffic will detour using **85th Street, U.S. 1 and Sebastian Boulevard**; southbound traffic uses the same connecting roads in reverse. Access to homes and businesses will be maintained. FDOT lists Dec. 6–10 as contingency dates.

Signal work is also planned at the **90th Avenue and Sebastian Boulevard intersection from 8 p.m. to 6 a.m. Thursday, Dec. 3**, with intermittent restrictions.

### Sebastian Inlet Bridge work and parking

**S.R. A1A/Jimmy Buffett Memorial Highway at Sebastian Inlet:** Traffic is using a temporary shifted roadway alignment established in October. FDOT expects the temporary pattern to remain through **late 2028** as the bridge replacement advances.

One northbound or southbound lane and/or shoulder may close as needed **7 a.m. to 5 p.m. Monday through Thursday** and **7 a.m. to 1 p.m. Friday**, excluding weekends and holidays, through December. Only one lane will close at a time, with flaggers directing motorists. FDOT says the project's lane and shoulder closures are not permitted Nov. 25–29.

Sections of the **north and south Sebastian Inlet State Park parking lots** remain partially closed during bridge construction. The park remains open, but parking is limited, the observation decks beneath the bridge are closed and **south-jetty access from the south parking lot is closed**. Access to the boat ramp will be maintained.

### Vero Beach road and utility work

Several Vero Beach-area roads may have daytime restrictions, generally **9 a.m. to 4 p.m.**: **northbound U.S. 1 between Bridge Boulevard and Durrance Road; northbound U.S. 1 between 61st Place and 63rd Street; U.S. 1 between 24th Street and 21st Street; and S.R. A1A near Mango Road and Shoe Drive**. These are scheduled on various dates through Dec. 4, with Thanksgiving work pauses on many projects.

**Oslo Road between Old Dixie Highway SW and Timber Ridge Trail SW** may have intermittent lane restrictions **9 a.m. to 4 p.m. Nov. 30–Dec. 4** for utility work. Additional lane restrictions are listed along **S.R. 60 near 97th Road, 98th Avenue, 33rd Avenue and 26th Avenue**, and along **S.R. A1A near Round Island Place and Ocean Estates Drive**.

## Before you travel

These are **planned construction and maintenance restrictions**, not reports of traffic incidents or guarantees that every closure will occur. Dates and work hours may change because of weather, contractor schedules or other conditions.

For real-time interstate traffic, consult [Florida 511](https://www.fl511.com/). For FDOT District 4 construction notices and updated lane-closure schedules, visit [D4FDOT.com](https://www.d4fdot.com/). This roundup is based on FDOT's Treasure Coast Traffic Report issued **Nov. 20, 2026**, covering **Nov. 20–Dec. 4**.
